decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the firm's core dumper range, has had its own page in both years, and sits in a growing industry, so nothing signals a shortfall against aspirations.
The articulated construction dumper builds directly on established competence and kept its own page in both years, so management has no reason to start problemistic search.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core and dropped from its own page to a mere mention in 2024, which hints at results below aspiration, but the firm's growth and hiring give it slack to carry this niche product a while longer.
The compact telescopic loader is a multi-model line close to the core with continued prominence, which fits a satisfactory product the firm will keep.
The material lift line reports strong rental popularity and a recent large order, so results clearly meet aspirations.
Although distant from the core, the underground mining loader shows strong quantified field performance (1,000 operating hours in 7 months) and has its own page, which supports keeping it.
